correctness.rationale: For the fixed channel B(x)={x}∪{x−e_i:x_i>0} on {0,1,2}^5, disjoint received balls are equivalent to the complete 243-variable, 243-receiver binary packing program. Independently reconstructed that incidence matrix and solved it with SciPy/HiGHS mixed-integer programming: objective 45, equal global dual bound 45, gap zero and optimal status. The source constructs the separate 1890-edge confusability independent-set formulation. The exact 45-word source witness, whose fetched Git blob is ef50915553c694efebfc5e84b16acf61e84be1d9, was independently checked to give 185 distinct received words and zero collisions. Thus 45≤opt≤45 conditional on the integrity of HiGHS numerical/branch-and-bound optimality reporting; two formulations do not constitute a solver-independent symbolic infeasibility certificate. Levels do not wrap and there is at most one downward one-level error including identity.
